questions: Should a table count as taken only when another booking has exactly the same time (e.g. 7:00 and 7:30 are both fine), or does each booking hold the table for a set length, such as 2 hours, so nearby times also clash?
Can customers pick any time, or only fixed slots or times within your opening hours? If limited, what are they?
Do you need a way to cancel a reservation so the table becomes free again?
answers: We just use the start time. Two reservations clash only if they are for the same table, the same date and the same time.
